global: A rich, golden miso ramen broth cradles tender chashu pork slices and crisp menma bamboo shoots, with vibrant spinach peeking through. Served in a white bowl with red “BAMAMAN” lettering, it rests on a textured red placemat under soft, even light.

regions.background: Red textured placemat with woven pattern, circular shape, smooth surface beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl features red repeating "WB" logos and text along its glossy rim.
regions.soup: The miso broth is golden-brown, smooth, and glossy, cradling pale noodles and dark green spinach leaves.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show pinkish meat with white fat marbling, slightly curled edges, and glossy sheen from broth.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, glossy, sliced into thick pieces with visible fibrous texture on their surfaces.
